member.name: M:src.Services.EntradasSaidasService.EntradasSaidasService.LoadEvolucaoDataAsync(System.String,System.Int32,System.DateTime,System.DateTime,System.Int32)
member.summary: Loads all data needed to build the Evolução series (time buckets + aggregates per direction).
member.remarks:
This method is the shared "core" for: - (JSON): applies API pagination to the final series.
What it returns: - Buckets: the timeline points (hours/days/months) to render. Buckets are pre-generated, so we can output zeros for periods with no movimentos. - Granularity: Hour/Day/Month, derived from tab and the requested window. - EntradasMap / SaidasMap: aggregated quantity per bucket for the selected direction(s).
Why use maps: We aggregate in SQL (fast), then later build the full bucketed series in memory by looking up each bucket in a dictionary (fast and predictable ordering).

member.summary: Builds the Evolução series as a flat list of , including zero-filled buckets.
member.remarks:
The returned list interleaves directions depending on : - tipo=0: only entradas - tipo=1: only saidas - tipo=2: entradas + saidas
Pagination is implemented using an index that counts output rows (not buckets), since when tipo=2 we output two rows per time bucket.
